task_description: Fix the authentication and anonymous user pipeline so that auth is NOT compulsory. Anonymous users (identified by IP/anon-id) should be able to access library, chat, and 5 chat history entries without logging in. Authenticated users get full access.

verification.summary: All 7 new anon access tests pass. All 6 auth tests pass. 180 tests pass total (3 pre-existing failures unrelated to this change). Security review issue fixed: anon_id is now validated against the pattern before MongoDB query.
